_comment: Cockpit team roster (generic seed for the JARVIS-OS Starter Kit). Fully data-driven: the cockpit UI and status probes read this file, so adding or renaming an agent needs no code change. Fields: key = Hermes profile name; name = display name; role/desc = shown in the UI; port = gateway API port (null = not deployed yet, status 'planned'); accent = UI accent colour token. No secrets, no personal data. Edit here or via scripts/setup.py to rename agents.

agents.name: JARVIS
agents.desc: Takes requests, routes to the team, bundles results back.

agents.name: Scout
agents.desc: Market and competitor research, comparisons, fact-checks.

agents.name: Ada
agents.desc: Builds tools and features on branches, opens PRs, never deploys.

agents.name: Scotty
agents.desc: Infra, monitoring, updates, backups, reviews and deploys.

agents.name: Pen
agents.desc: Drafts posts, articles and emails in the user's voice.
